companies.name: Shepherd Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks. We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We also provide integration into customers’ existing workflows, starting with data center construction and operations, electrical manufacturing and testing, and electronics manufacturing, where traditional automation struggles with variability, dexterity, and changing environments.
companies.story: 这是做通用机器人的公司，方向是把机器人放进人工智能基础设施和先进制造这些需要熟练体力活的场景。假如你是一家数据中心的施工负责人，今天现场要赶一批电气安装和测试，可熟练工人排不开，环境又一直在变，传统自动化设备根本应付不了这种灵活度要求。Shepherd Robotics 的做法是让机器人依靠机器人基础模型，用模块化硬件去适应不同环境和任务，训练数据来自真实世界与仿真，还提供接入客户现有工作流程的整合服务，先从数据中心建设与运营、电气制造与测试、电子制造切入。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有 4 个人，它值得看的地方在于直接盯住了传统自动化最难处理的多变、精细和换环境问题。

companies.name: Kestrel AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agents for Platform Engineering
companies.originalDescription: Kestrel is the AI automation layer for platform engineering teams. Platform teams use Kestrel to automate incident response, cloud provisioning, CI/CD, security, and developer requests across their stack. Kestrel turns natural-language prompts into deterministic, production-ready workflows with 40+ integrations, 200+ pre-built actions, and support for custom HTTP and webhook actions. Developer-first, with a CLI, Python SDK, and MCP server to manage workflows from where platform teams already work.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是平台工程团队的人工智能自动化层。想象你是一个平台工程负责人，凌晨被告警叫醒，一边要处理线上事故，一边还有开发同事在排队等云资源开通和权限申请，日常的持续集成、安全配置也压在你身上。Kestrel AI 让平台团队用自然语言描述需求，转成确定性的、可直接上生产的工作流，内置 40 多个集成和 200 多个预置动作，也支持自定义网络请求和回调动作，并提供命令行工具、Python 开发包和 MCP 服务器，让团队在原本的工作环境里管理流程。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队 2 人，值得关注的是它把事故响应、云资源开通、持续集成与安全这些零散工作收进一个自动化入口。

companies.name: Channel3
companies.originalOneLiner: Database of every product on the internet
companies.originalDescription: Channel3 is building a database of every product on the internet. Google and OpenAI maintain vast product graphs, but keep that valuable data to themselves. Channel3 gives every developer access, opening a world of possibility for new shopping experiences across any vertical. For instance, developers could build AI fashion stylists or give their agents shopping capabilities. We don’t just collect product data; we actually understand it. With the latest image classification and reasoning models, we can match products across merchants—even when listings and images differ—recognize variants, and surface the perfect matches for every search. As we grow, we’ll capture unique insights into what users want, click, and buy. As AI models get smarter and cheaper, our flywheel accelerates: our catalog will improve, and it will be even easier for developers and vibe-coders to build on our infrastructure. To further incentivize building on Channel3, we provide built-in monetization; developers earn commissions on sales they drive. Alex discovered this need while building an AI tutor that could recommend products and earn affiliate revenue. When no solution existed, he persuaded his smartest friend from Duke and former co-founder George to leave Palantir and build Channel3 together.
companies.story: 这是做电商商品数据库的公司，目标是收录互联网上的每一件商品。如果你是一个正在开发购物助手的开发者，用户发来一张街拍照片问哪里有同款，你手里没有可靠的商品数据，只能一个个商家去爬，图片和标题还对不上。Channel3 用图像分类和推理模型去理解商品，即使不同商家的商品页面和图片有差异，也能把同一件商品匹配起来，识别出不同款式，并为每次搜索给出合适的匹配结果。它的思路是谷歌和 OpenAI 各自维护着庞大的商品图谱却只留给自己用，而它把这份能力开放给每一个开发者，让时装搭配助手或带购物能力的智能体都能建起来。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 5 人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Tenor
companies.originalOneLiner: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native businesses.
companies.originalDescription: Tenor is a full-stack infrastructure for building and running AI-native businesses. We’re not just an agent framework, we manage the entire loop from how AI executes work to how every action, decision, and business outcome is captured and learned from. Owning the full stack lets companies deploy governed AI workflows, understand what actually drives results, and continuously improve how their business operates without building the infrastructure themselves.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让人工智能原生业务得以搭建和扩张的全栈基础设施。假如你是一家公司的运营负责人，已经让智能体接手了不少实际工作，可每个动作、每次决策和最终业务结果散落在不同系统里，没人说得清到底是什么在推动结果，想改进也无从下手。Tenor 不只提供一个智能体框架，而是把从人工智能执行工作到记录并学习每个动作、决策和业务结果这一整条链路都管起来，企业因此可以部署受治理的人工智能工作流，看清真正驱动结果的因素，并持续优化业务运转，不必自己从头搭这套基础设施。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘，值得看的是它把治理和结果学习一起放进了基础设施里。

companies.name: Egoist Machines
companies.originalOneLiner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
companies.originalDescription: Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose. AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data. Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access. We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers. The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use. Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.
companies.story: 这是做个人上下文基础设施的公司，想让你的个人信息归你自己所有，而不是散落在各个应用和人工智能公司手里。如果你是一个常用多个人工智能助手的普通用户，你在一个助手那里说过自己的偏好和经历，换到另一个产品又得从头解释一遍，每个应用都在悄悄构建一个版本的你。Egoist Machines 推出的 人工智能 Passport 把这些助手和日常应用里产生的上下文汇成一个可携带、由你掌控的个人档案，比如你在 ChatGPT 里说过的事，Claude 也能知道，换到新产品第一次交互它就能理解你，而新公司不需要拥有底层数据。应用通过 人工智能 Passport 登录接入，只申请特定用途和时长所需的上下文。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得看的是它把隐私和可携带性做成了产品本身。

companies.name: Qlo
companies.originalOneLiner: Legora for commercial insurance carriers
companies.originalDescription: Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter. We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是商业保险承保环节，用智能体来跑承保运营。想象你是一名商业保险公司的核保人员，桌上堆着不同格式的投保材料，风险判断前后还有大量录入、核对和流转工作，系统和规则又各管一摊，人跟机器很难在同一份账户上协作。Qlo 先从风险决策周边的运营工作做起，把这些环节自动化，再成为记录系统，然后一个工作流一个工作流地获得自主权，朝自主人工智能核保员推进。它从底层重建承保基础设施，让人工核保员和智能体共享同一套账户、规则、文档、权限和工作流状态。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得关注的是它选择从运营切入而不是直接喊全自动。

companies.name: b12 Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
companies.originalDescription: b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference. Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers. We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
companies.story: 这是做难合成分子、服务药企和生物科技公司的公司，把人工智能和机器人实验室结合起来。如果你是一家药企早期研发的负责人，手里有一批结构复杂、传统路线很难做出来的候选分子，每试一轮都要等很久，迭代周期一拖就是几年。b12 Labs 帮药企规划和合成这些高价值分子，把早期药物发现从数年压缩到数月。团队方面，Andres 做过第一个能在机器人实验室里自主思考和合成分子的智能体，成果发表在 Nature Machine Intelligence，引用超过一千次，还拿过 NeurIPS 人工智能 for Science 会议的最佳论文奖，Zlatko 则是三次国家化学奥林匹克冠军，在罗氏和领先实验室机器人公司做过药物化学。他们正在与大药企做付费试点，平台规划的一组实验一次就达到完全转化，省掉了反复迭代。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Alt-X
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the best venue for private markets exposure.
companies.originalDescription: Alt-X is building the AI-native liquidity layer for private markets. Private markets have created trillions of dollars in value, yet remain fragmented, illiquid, and inaccessible. While public markets benefit from exchanges, market makers, brokerages, and data infrastructure, private markets still rely on brokers, spreadsheets, and manual workflows to connect buyers and sellers. Alt-X uses AI to automate the core functions required to make private assets liquid. We streamline diligence, valuation, investor matching, and transaction execution, reducing the friction that makes private-market transactions slow, expensive, and opaque today. Our initial focus is venture-backed secondaries. We source opportunities from founders, employees, and early investors while building a network of accredited investors seeking exposure to the world's most valuable private companies. Over time, we believe every private asset—from startup equity to private credit and alternative investments—will require modern liquidity infrastructure. Building trusted infrastructure for private markets is difficult. Transactions involve complex diligence, fragmented information, transfer restrictions, and significant compliance requirements. Alt-X is focused on creating systems that can support real transactions at scale, not just marketplace listings. Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel commodities trader) and Michael Wachsman (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) are building Alt-X because they believe ownership of innovation should be more liquid, transparent, and accessible. Today, Alt-X has sourced over $1.5 million in transaction opportunities and assembled a network of 40 accredited investors representing hundreds of millions of dollars in investable assets. Our mission is to democratize ownership of innovation by building the financial infrastructure that private markets have never had.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是私募市场的流动性层，用人工智能把原本靠人撮合的交易流程自动化。假如你是一名持有创业公司股权的早期投资人，想在有生之年把一部分份额变现，可买家在哪里、怎么估值、尽职调查怎么做，全靠经纪人和表格来回拉扯，一笔交易又慢又贵还不透明。Alt-X 用人工智能去处理尽职调查、估值、投资人与标的匹配和交易执行这些核心环节，降低摩擦，最初聚焦创业公司支持的二级份额，从创始人、员工和早期投资人那里获取机会，同时搭建一个寻求接触全球高价值私有公司的合格投资人网络。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得看的是它把公开市场早就有的交易所和数据基础设施思路搬到了私募市场。

companies.name: Pacific
companies.originalOneLiner: Mass-producing and financing micro data center incredibly quickly.
companies.originalDescription: We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week. Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue. Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是模块化数据中心的量产和融资，把闲置电力变成算力收入。如果你是一个基建项目的负责人，工地因为各种原因停摆，接入的电容量就那样空着，每周都在为债务付利息，损失以十亿美元计。Pacific 量产模块化数据中心，几天内就能部署到这些停滞的站点上，把原本用不上的电力变成收入，冷却系统里用了金刚石晶圆，所以舱体在地球上任何地方都能运行，沙漠里也行。他们的判断是数据中心常常要等好几年才能拿到电力，而全球各地延迟的工地正握着闲置的接入容量。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 6 人，值得关注的是它把算力供给和停滞基建这两个看似无关的痛点接在了一起。

companies.name: ChemPilot.ai
companies.originalOneLiner: Discover novel defense related materials/molecules.
companies.originalDescription: ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial and error. We compress that to months by screening for what can actually be made, then closing the loop: every lab result feeds back into the models so the next round is faster and smarter. Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. Together we bring chemical engineering, computational chemistry and AI, plus the production systems to put them to work. ChemPilot spun out of that research. The West’s defense and dual-use industrial base runs on materials with fragile, sole-source and often adversarial supply chains. Demand for new capability is surging, and materials still take decades to develop. We’re building a new kind of chemical prime: one that can discover, develop and ultimately manufacture the materials the West needs, securely, fast and at cost.
companies.story: 这是做国防相关新材料和新分子发现的公司，用人工智能加上自动化湿实验室的数据来加速研发。如果你是一家国防承包商或政府研发机构的材料研究员，要为一款新装备找一种能用的材料，按今天的做法得花十年以上反复试错，而供应链上很多关键材料只有单一来源，甚至来自对手。ChemPilot 先筛选哪些材料真的做得出来，再让每一轮实验结果回流到模型里，下一轮更快更准，把十年压缩到几个月。三位创始人在首席科学顾问、前麻省理工博士后 Alon Grinberg Dana 教授的技术ion实验室里研究了两年这类材料，直接与国防主承包商和政府研发机构合作，公司从这项研究中分拆出来。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队 3 人，值得看的是它瞄准的是西方国防工业基础里供应链脆弱的材料环节。

readings.title: AI startup hacks Anthropic, gains access to employee details, internal messages
readings.story: 很多做 人工智能 产品的团队，平时最担心的往往不是模型效果，而是自己手里那些员工信息、内部聊天记录到底安不安全。一旦有人公开说攻破了某家知名公司，讨论就会迅速热起来。这篇值得读的地方，在于它把安全事件放进了创业公司的语境里：一家年轻公司做了什么、对方的防线在哪里松动。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述攻击的入口和时间线，哪些细节是确证的，哪些只是转述，这样更容易判断这类消息该信几分。

readings.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
readings.story: 当一个平台公司推出一项新能力，外界常常先替它想象出一连串被颠覆的行业，可现实里这些变化往往迟迟不发生。做产品或者看市场的人，都会在某个时刻遇到这种落差：发布会讲得很热闹，真正用起来的人却不多。这篇值得读，是因为它没有停在预测上，而是去追问为什么还没发生。读的时候不妨看作者如何区分能力本身和落地条件，比如谁有动力先用、什么环节挡住了它，这比记住结论更有用。

readings.title: A Spark Of Color In November’s Gray (2026 Wallpapers Edition)
readings.story: 每到换季，设计师和普通用户都会碰到一件小事：屏幕上的壁纸看久了想换一张，可挑来挑去总觉得差点意思。这类月度壁纸合集看起来轻，却常常是很多人打开设计站点的理由。它值得读的地方，不在于信息量，而在于可以当作一个观察口味的样本：同一批创作者在同一个月份里怎么处理颜色和情绪。读的时候可以留意每张图的构图和配色选择，想想它们分别适合什么场景，也许能给自己手头的界面找点灵感。

companies.name: Floot
companies.originalOneLiner: The app platform inside Claude and ChatGPT.
companies.originalDescription: Floot is the layer where vibecoded software runs. SaaS is dead. Hundreds of millions of people already spend their day in Claude or ChatGPT - and increasingly, when they need an app, they won't buy one. They'll describe it, and it will exist. We're building the infrastructure that makes that real. When Claude creates an app, it needs somewhere for that app to live: a backend, a database, hosting, a domain, the ability to scale, various services, maybe even to be able to work as a mobile app. Floot is that place - a full stack purpose-built for AI to operate, from a specialized framework that defines how AI writes and runs code, down to scalable hosting on AWS. This means you can now build and ship real apps directly inside Claude and ChatGPT. Connect Floot, and the model you already pay for writes and debugs the code, shows a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. No need to wire up git, vercel, supabase and a dozen other providers. And no AI credits - every message runs on the subscription you already have, because we charge for the platform, not for a token markup. We built Floot this way because we've watched the model layer commoditize - every serious builder writes good code now, including us. The lasting value isn't another agent between you and the model. It's the layer underneath, from wherever people already are. We're building Floot to be the home for all operation software, for the decades where most new software on earth is written by AI. ✨ Try it: floot.com
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人工智能应用运行的基础设施。假如你是一位产品经理，平时习惯在 Claude 里把想法描述清楚，让它写出一个内部小工具，可代码生成之后你发现没地方放：数据库、托管、域名、扩容都要自己折腾。Floot 就是给这类应用准备的落脚点，它把后端、数据库、托管和域名打包成一套专门让模型来操作的全栈环境，你连上之后，模型负责写代码和调试，实时预览，再发布到你自己的域名。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，场景本身也值得看：越来越多人不再买现成软件，而是直接描述出一个应用。

companies.name: Helios Intelligence
companies.originalOneLiner: At-home molecular body test: 1,000+ biomarkers from a drop of blood
companies.originalDescription: Helios is building a molecular body test from a single drop of blood. Our at-home test measures more than 1,000 biomarkers and turns them into a living model of the body—designed to show what is happening now, surface risk earlier, and become more useful with every test. By combining longitudinal molecular data with labs, wearables, health records, and outcomes, we are building toward a world model of human biology. Our goal is to simulate all of human health and use that intelligence to help people perform, recover, and live longer.
companies.story: 这是做居家健康检测的公司，把一次采血变成对身体的长期观察。假如你是一位四十多岁、体检报告年年说“基本正常”却总觉得状态下滑的上班族，你不想为了一点模糊的担心反复跑医院，又希望早点看到身体里正在发生的变化。Helios 的居家检测只需一滴血，就能测量超过一千项分子指标，并把这些数据与实验室结果、可穿戴设备、健康记录和后续结果放在一起，逐步形成对个人身体的动态模型。它值得关注的地方在于，这不是一个只记录步数的手机应用，而是把检测能力放进居家采血的场景里，让分子层面的信息能持续积累。公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Perspectives Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI to run behavioral health programs better
companies.originalDescription: America is facing an addiction and mental health crisis, but the treatment programs trying to solve the problem are faced with administrative burden, staff shortages, and pressure from payers. We work with treatment programs to incorporate AI that reduces administrative burden, prevents insurance denials, and helps directors run their program better. Our agents analyze charts to prevent insurance denials, complete documentation and insurance paperwork to save staff time, and sift through historical data to find opportunities for improvement.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是行为健康治疗机构的运营后台。想象你是一家戒瘾与心理治疗项目的负责人，治疗师本来就紧缺，保险申诉和文书却越堆越多，一次拒赔就可能让整个项目现金流吃紧。Perspectives Health 用智能体帮这类机构减轻行政负担，分析病历以提前发现可能导致拒赔的问题，代填文档和保险材料，节省员工时间，还会翻查历史数据找出可以改进的环节。它值得看的地方在于，它服务的不是普通诊所，而是正承受成瘾与心理健康危机压力、同时被付款方挤压的治疗项目。公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人。

companies.name: Moss
companies.originalOneLiner: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI
companies.originalDescription: Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural. If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs. Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.
companies.story: 这是做对话式人工智能检索基础设施的公司。如果你负责过一个语音智能体产品，大概经历过那种尴尬：用户问完话，智能体停顿了一两秒，原本自然的感觉瞬间消失。瓶颈往往在检索环节，每次查询都要跨网络和数据库跳转，带来延迟和成本。Moss 把检索放到智能体运行的地方附近，原生运行在浏览器、手机和服务器上，内置用 Rust 和 WebAssembly 写的向量索引，目标是让语音智能体、助手和聊天界面在十毫秒以内完成检索与回应。它值得关注，因为对话体验的流畅度直接决定用户是否愿意继续使用。公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Manufact
companies.originalOneLiner: Cloud infrastructure for MCP servers and Claude / ChatGPT plugins.
companies.originalDescription: Manufact is the MCP cloud platform to get your product ready for Claude Connectors marketplace, ChatGPT / Codex plugins store and any AI agent that supports MCP. We're the team behind mcp-use SDK, the open-source framework for building MCP Apps with 10k github stars and 10M+ downloads across python and typescript. It's the fastest and most complete solution for production-ready MCP servers.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让人工智能产品接入智能体生态的云基础设施。假如你是某款软件的工程负责人，老板要求产品尽快出现在 Claude 连接器市场或 ChatGPT 插件商店里，你却发现从协议适配到部署上线处处是坑。Manufact 提供 MCP 云平台，帮产品接入这些市场以及任何支持 MCP 的智能体。团队还维护开源框架 mcp-use，用于构建 MCP 应用，在 GitHub 上有约一万颗星，Python 和 TypeScript 版本合计下载超过一千万次。它值得看的地方在于，智能体生态正在快速扩张，而接入层的基础设施会成为很多产品的必经之路。公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Origin
companies.originalOneLiner: AI and Data for Cancer Therapeutics
companies.originalDescription: We produce patient-derived cancer datasets for licensing to pharmaceutical and AI companies. Our data comprises matched spatial transcriptomics, H&E and clinical labels. We operate our own laboratory, where samples are processed. Samples are sourced from leading biobank / hospital networks. As R&D workflows increasingly rely on frontier AI systems, we believe there is critical need for real world datapoints so that findings translate in the clinic.
companies.story: 这是做癌症治疗数据与药物发现的公司。设想你是一家制药公司或人工智能团队的研究员，手里有强大的模型，却缺少能真正对应临床结果的真实世界数据，训练出来的发现在实验室里好看，到了病人身上未必成立。Origin 自己运营实验室处理样本，样本来自合作的生物样本库和医院网络，产出匹配的空间转录组、病理图像和临床标签数据集，授权给制药与人工智能公司使用。它值得关注，因为研发流程越来越依赖前沿人工智能系统，而真实数据点正是让发现能在临床落地的关键。公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队八人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Darwin
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots to build civilization
companies.originalDescription: Darwin Robotics creates general-purpose robots to build and maintain the machines civilization runs on. We're starting with AI infrastructure, where skilled technicians perform a long tail of physical work across assembly, installation, commissioning, and maintenance. Our robots learn new tasks from demonstrations rather than being explicitly programmed for each workflow. First deployments are planned for early 2027.
companies.story: 这是做人形通用机器人的硬科技公司，方向是让机器人去建造和维护文明运转所依赖的机器。想象你是一家人工智能基础设施公司的运维负责人，机房和产线里总有一长串零散的体力活：装配、安装、调试、维护，熟练技师难找也难留。Darwin 的机器人通过演示学习新任务，而不是为每个流程单独编程，首批部署计划在 2027 年初，先从人工智能基础设施场景切入。它值得看的地方在于，它瞄准的不是演示视频里的花活，而是真实设施里那部分长期缺人的体力工作。公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。

companies.name: KelAI
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI Quant: Autonomous Alpha Engine for Funds and Traders.
companies.originalDescription: Founded by former WorldQuant portfolio manager & head of event driven systematic strategies Jeremie Cohen, KelAI is building the autonomous alpha engine for hedge funds, traders and institutional investors. Investment teams now have more data, tools and compute than ever, but research still runs across siloed systems and inefficient workflows. KelAI turns that fragmented process into a compounding AI-native engine that continuously finds, tests and validates trading signals at a pace no human team can match.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是对冲基金和交易团队的研究流程。如果你是一名量化研究员，每天面对的数据、工具和算力都比前辈多，可研究仍然散落在彼此割裂的系统里，找信号、做回测、验证想法全靠人力堆时间。KelAI 想把这套碎片化流程变成一个持续运转的人工智能引擎，不断发现、测试和验证交易信号，速度超出人类团队。公司由前 WorldQuant 投资组合经理、事件驱动系统化策略负责人 Jeremie Cohen 创办。它值得关注的地方在于，它赌的是研究流程本身可以被自动化并不断累积优势。公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Hundred
companies.originalOneLiner: 100% automated inspection for consumer electronics parts
companies.originalDescription: Hundred is an automated inspection system for the components that make up consumer devices like phones, smartwatches, and laptops. Hundred helps factories cut waste and prevent line-down issues by catching sub-100µm cosmetic defects before parts reach the assembly line. In the consumer electronics industry, designs change so fast that traditional machine vision can't keep up, forcing factories to rely on manual inspection, literally people checking parts under microscopes to sort out bad parts. Human inspectors miss roughly 15% of defects, and a single bad part can turn a finished device into scrap. Hundred is replacing manual inspection with an imaging rig that scans an entire shipping tray of parts at once. The Hundred rig blocks ambient light and uses varied controlled lighting configurations to detect defects smaller than 100µm on a range of materials. The controlled environment means Hundred only needs to scan a single good part before it can find defects, categorize them, and assess their severity accurately. Defects cost U.S. discrete manufacturers $45 billion a year, a problem Hundred's CEO, Erica, saw firsthand as a mechanical engineer designing devices at Meta, Google, and Magic Leap. She met Imani, Hundred's CPO, at Columbia University's admitted-students day in 2017 and Imani went on to spend five years at Twitch building software that handles billions of requests a day. Erica later met Iris, Hundred's CTO, in the Bay Area. Iris worked as a quant at Citadel before pivoting to study at Imperial College London where she researched machine learning on 3D meshes and other structured data. Together, they're building Hundred because manual inspection shouldn't still exist in 2026.
companies.story: 这是做消费电子零部件自动检测的硬件公司。想象你是一家手机或智能手表零件工厂的质检主管，设计改版越来越快，传统机器视觉跟不上，只能让工人趴在显微镜下一个一个看，而人眼大约会漏掉一成半的缺陷，一个坏零件就可能让整台成品报废。Hundred 用一套成像设备一次扫描整盘来料，隔绝环境光并用多种受控光照，找出小于一百微米的表面缺陷，在零件上装配线之前就拦下来。它值得关注，因为这不是手机应用，而是把视觉能力装进产线上的设备与光学系统里。公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队三人。

companies.name: Exosat
companies.originalOneLiner: Building a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink
companies.originalDescription: Exosat is building thousands of low-cost communication satellites to provide a neutral, sovereign alternative to Starlink. By designing our satellites with zero ITAR/EAR-controlled content, we can leverage manufacturers anywhere in the world to produce our satellites at under a tenth of the cost and launch them from other nations to bypass capacity bottlenecks and access equatorial orbits. We're starting off by selling connectivity to device OEMs and network operators, but will eventually use the distributed compute across our constellation to run low-latency inference for robots and autonomous vehicles in remote and rural areas anywhere on the planet. We've already signed hundreds of millions in LOIs to work with operators across Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, booked our first satellite launch next year, and hold an 11,000 satellite filing with the ITU to build the largest comms network outside of the U.S. and China.
companies.story: 这是做低轨通信卫星的公司，目标是给星链提供一个中立且主权可控的替代方案。假如你是一家设备厂商或区域网络运营商的负责人，你想给偏远地区的用户提供连接，却发现可选供应商有限、排期漫长、条件也不由自己掌握。Exosat 设计卫星时避开受出口管制的部件，从而能在世界各地采购制造，把成本压到十分之一以下，并从其他国家发射以绕开运力瓶颈、进入赤道轨道。它先向设备厂商和网络运营商卖连接服务，未来还打算用星座上的分布式算力为偏远地区的机器人和自动驾驶车辆做低延迟推理。公司称已与中亚、东南亚和中东的运营商签署数亿美元意向书，首颗卫星定于明年发射，并在国际电信联盟持有 11000 颗卫星的申报。公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人。

readings.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach
readings.story: 平时我们总以为交易所被黑是电影里的情节，直到某天新闻弹出巨额数字，才意识到数字资产的安全问题离普通人并不远。团队里负责风控或安全的人，也会在某个深夜突然被问起：我们的资产真的安全吗？这篇报道值得读，因为它把一次创纪录的失窃事件摆到台前，让人看到攻击者如何找到缺口。读的时候可以留意作者如何梳理事件脉络，以及各方如何回应，这能帮你判断安全防线到底卡在哪里。

readings.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
readings.story: 当公司开始把 人工智能 助手放进日常办公，产品经理和工程师很快会遇到一个尴尬问题：演示时表现不错，真到员工手里却经常答非所问。于是大家开始琢磨，怎么在真实数据上评估它到底靠不靠谱。这篇文章来自微软研究院，讨论的正是从模拟企业数据走向真实场景的信心建立过程。读的时候可以看作者如何设计评估步骤，以及他们怎样判断哪些指标真正反映用户信任，而不是只看分数。

readings.title: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
readings.story: 如果你最近在关注减肥药、城市治理或者饮用水安全，可能会发现这些话题看似不相关，却都牵涉到技术如何进入日常生活。普通读者翻开科技新闻时，常常被零散标题弄得摸不着头脑。这篇来自 MIT Technology Review 的汇总，把几个正在发酵的议题放在一起，适合想快速了解背景的人。读的时候可以注意编辑如何挑选和排列这些话题，以及每个短条目里点出了哪些关键变化和争议。

companies.name: Corelayer
companies.originalOneLiner: AI production engineer for regulated industries
companies.originalDescription: Corelayer is the AI-native platform for production software support, built for regulated industries like finance and healthcare. It continuously monitors alerts, logs, infrastructure, and underlying data for issues and uses agents to debug and suggest fixes. We're helping SRE, production services, and on-call engineers at companies ranging from growth-stage fintechs to Fortune 500 financial institutions spend less time on support and more on high-leverage work.
companies.story: 这是给金融、医疗等受监管行业做生产软件支持的公司。假如你是某家银行的当班工程师，凌晨系统告警不断，日志、基础设施和底层数据都要你一项项翻，问题到底出在哪常常要花上几个小时。Corelayer 会持续盯着这些信号，用智能体帮你排查并给出修复建议，让你把时间放回真正有价值的工作上。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队只有三人，规模很小，但切入的是受监管行业最不敢出错的环节，这种场景本身就值得关注。

companies.name: OpenCrawl
companies.originalOneLiner: Search infrastructure, built for your agents.
companies.originalDescription: OpenCrawl lets agents search over hard-to-find multimodal data. Agents describe the data they need; OpenCrawl finds the sources, then builds and hosts custom crawlers, processing and search indexes. Each index is tuned to be the fastest, most accurate search over that data. Developers wire it into their products through MCP, CLI or API. Teams use it to find answers across their own files, tools and legacy systems.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是给智能体用的搜索基础设施。想象你正在开发一个内部助手，它要回答的问题散落在图片、文档和一堆老旧系统里，普通搜索根本找不到。OpenCrawl 让智能体先描述需要什么数据，然后由它去找来源，搭建并托管专门的抓取程序和搜索索引，开发者通过接口把它接进自己的产品。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，面对的是多模态数据越来越难检索的现实，这个方向值得留意。

companies.name: Cumulus Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS
companies.originalDescription: Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI. We replace that entire stack with a single unified platform. Developers can keep their existing code while instantly upgrading to a unified platform that handles routing, semantic caching, continuous shadow evaluation, simulated data, and one-click fine-tuning. Behind the platform is Ion, our proprietary inference engine running on a custom NVIDIA Grace GPU fleet. Ion uses in-house custom GPU kernels to deliver 30 to 50 percent more throughput than standard vLLM or SGLang, giving our customers SOTA inference economics.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是多模态推理的操作系统。想象你是一个工程负责人，团队要做人工智能产品，却得为路由、可观测性、评测、微调和推理分别对接不同供应商，拼起来又贵又脆。Cumulus Labs 用一个统一平台替掉这整条链路，开发者保留原有代码就能获得语义缓存、持续影子评测、模拟数据和一键微调，底层是跑在英伟达 Grace 图形处理器集群上的自研推理引擎。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人，宣称吞吐比常见方案高三到五成，这个性能主张值得关注。

companies.name: Covera
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native OS for insurance brokers
companies.originalDescription: Covera is the AI-native operating system for independent P&C insurance agencies. It lives inside the agency's AMS and inbox and runs agentic AI workflows across the whole client journey, from the first email to the next renewal. Producers quote first and win more business; CSRs and account managers stop retyping data. Submissions, for producers: every new request becomes a ready file, one click keys every carrier portal for a first quote during the call, quotes come back side by side, and binding updates the AMS with no double entry. Servicing, for CSRs and account managers: answers about any account with their source, COIs and follow-ups drafted, renewal reminders 90, 60 and 30 days out with remarketing when premiums jump, and coverage gaps across the book turned into cross-sell leads. Agencies using Covera go from lead to quote in 5 minutes, save 10 hours a week per user and win 20% more deals against competitors. Every action is reviewed by the agency team and logged for E&O. Works with Applied Epic, AMS360, QQCatalyst, HawkSoft, EZLynx, Momentum, Gmail and Outlook. Built by the founders of Simio (conversational AI, acquired in 2024).
companies.story: 这是给独立财产与意外险代理机构做人工智能操作系统的公司。一个代理机构的客户服务人员每天要在管理系统和邮箱之间来回切换，客户信息反复录入，续保提醒全靠人记。Covera 住在机构现有的管理系统和收件箱里，把从第一封邮件到下一次续保的流程交给智能体跑，报价能并排比较，绑定后数据自动回写。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人，瞄准的是保险中介日常最琐碎也最耗人的部分。

companies.name: Soria
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Financial Research Terminal built for Healthcare (and beyond)
companies.originalDescription: Soria is an AI-native Financial Terminal for investors who specialize in a particular sector, starting with healthcare. Our agents convert hundreds of the most important public and private sources into an always-on financial model, reviewed by domain experts and delivered to hedge funds, banks, and asset managers through a terminal UI, MCP, API, warehouse sync, and research feed. Unlike our competitors, we own the data layer and expand bottom-up, one sector at a time - additionally our agents proactively do research on behalf of our clients without them lifting a finger or sharing any data.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是面向医疗行业投资者的金融研究终端。如果你是一位只看医疗赛道的对冲基金分析师，每天要在几百个公开和私有信息源里翻数据，模型更新慢、口径还不一致。Soria 的智能体会把这些来源持续转成一份一直在更新的财务模型，由领域专家复核，再通过终端界面、接口和研究信息流送到你面前。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队三人，选择先吃透一个行业再往外扩，这个路径值得关注。

companies.name: Neuromorphic
companies.originalOneLiner: Building robots to automate wetlabs
companies.originalDescription: We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!
companies.story: 这家公司做的是能在现有湿实验室里自主工作的机器人。想象你是一位实验室技术员，每天在几个工作站之间搬运耗材、操作仪器、重复同样的实验步骤。Neuromorphic 的机器人不需要专门设备，它自己在工作站之间移动，操作现有的科学仪器，用和人一样的实验室设施完成实验，还能通过聊天工具和邮件来管理。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队三人，把机器人当作新员工来部署的思路，让这个硬科技方向值得关注。

companies.name: BioStack Platforms
companies.originalOneLiner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
companies.originalDescription: BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments. We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗和药物研发人工智能模型的数据引擎。假如你在一家人工智能实验室负责训练医疗模型，最头疼的往往不是模型本身，而是拿不到高质量、结构化的真实生物医学数据，临床和实验数据散在医院、实验室和外包研究机构里。BioStack 用自有的临床和临床前数据管道，把影像、电子病历和实验检测等纵向多模态数据整理成可训练的环境，供模型做后训练和强化学习。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队十一人，切中的正是行业公认的数据瓶颈。

companies.name: Moonshot
companies.originalOneLiner: agents for the rest of us
companies.originalDescription: We want to bring AI agents to a billion people. To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector. Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life. For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot. Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable. Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf. Take life personally. The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail. Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team. Let's make it a Moonshot.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向普通人的个人智能体。如果你是一个每天事情很多、脑子里总挂着几件没做完的事的人，Moonshot 会住在你的手机里持续倾听，慢慢建立起对你的理解，像好朋友那样留意你的生活。它会在你意识到之前提醒你那些悬着的事，发现情绪和生活的变化趋势。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，想法是让软件从被动等待提问变成主动提供价值，这个转变本身值得看。

companies.name: Scheduling Wizard
companies.originalOneLiner: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
companies.originalDescription: Scheduling Wizard is building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations. Hospitals still rely on manual workflows to manage staffing, patient flow, and core operations, contributing to $760B in annual inefficiency. 20 departments across 16 hospitals already outsource their physician scheduling to us, powered by our internal Scheduling Programming Language and AI-driven workflows. We work with Mass General, Johns Hopkins, UT Southwestern, UCSF, and many others. We are actively onboarding new clients and expanding into patient triaging and provider management systems, working with partner departments at UCSF and other leading institutions. Scheduling Wizard aims to bring healthcare operations into the future by reducing administrative burden and improving clinical care coordination. Our goal is to create the AI-native administrative layer in healthcare operations.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗机构的排班与运营物流基础设施。假如你是一家医院某个科室的负责人，医生排班靠手工表格，病人流转和人员调度全靠人盯，一出错就影响整个科室。Scheduling Wizard 用自研的排班编程语言和人工智能流程，替十六家医院的二十个科室承接医生排班，客户包括麻省总医院、约翰斯·霍普金斯、西南医学中心和加州大学旧金山分校等。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在向病人分诊和医生管理系统扩展，已有真实医院在用，这一点值得关注。

companies.name: Ageospatial
companies.originalOneLiner: Physical intelligence for every decision with Geospatial AI.
companies.originalDescription: Ageospatial helps organizations value the risk on their physical assets (properties, land, infrastructure) remotely using satellite imagery. 97% of commercial properties are never physically inspected because it's too slow and expensive. So insurers price risk based on what the client or broker tells them, and about half the time at least one of those records is wrong. The result is mispricing, fraud, and an estimated $36B in premium leakage every year in the US alone, which gets exposed the moment a disaster hits. Upload a list of addresses and their GeoAI reads satellite and street-level imagery, maps, real-time data, public records and the insurer's own data to determine what's really there, which natural and human hazards surround it, what changed over time, and which properties are worth inspecting. Each property becomes a living record that underwriting, claims and pricing teams can trace from past to present. Ageospatial deploys inside carriers and MGAs as an AI-native service, so insurers get outcomes delivered.
companies.story: 这家公司用卫星影像帮机构评估实体资产的风险。如果你是一位保险承保人员，手上一批商业地产从来没被实地看过，风险定价只能听客户或经纪人怎么说，而这些记录里大约一半至少有一项是错的，灾害一来问题就暴露。Ageospatial 让你上传地址清单，它读取卫星和街景影像、地图、实时数据、公共记录以及保险公司自己的数据，判断那里实际有什么、周边有哪些自然和人为风险、随时间发生了什么变化。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队一人，针对的是美国每年估计三百六十亿美元的保费漏损，这个切口值得看。

readings.title: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
readings.story: 很多人第一次养电子宠物，是在手机里喂一只像素小猫，它饿了会叫，你走了它也不会真的难过。如今大公司开始把这类陪伴感做成真正的产品，问题就来了：它到底是玩具，还是一个会持续收集你生活细节的入口。这篇值得读，是因为它把一个看起来轻松的应用，放回了 人工智能 产品竞争和基础设施投入的背景里。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述这类产品的定位，以及它和 Meta 现有业务之间的关系，看它是在讲一个新玩具，还是在讲一种新的用户习惯。

readings.title: Game Devs Just Started Pulling Their Demos Off Steam [video]
readings.story: 独立游戏开发者常把试玩版放到 Steam 上，靠玩家反馈和愿望单积累人气，可平台规则一变，原本的推广方式就可能反过来变成负担。这条讨论出现在技术社区，说明它触动的是一群靠小团队和有限预算做事的人。读的时候不妨先想，为什么开发者会选择把已经放出去的试玩版收回来，是成本、规则，还是玩家预期变了。然后看视频里怎么讲这件事的来龙去脉，留意作者是从开发者处境出发，还是从平台机制出发，这决定了你该怎么判断它值不值得跟进。

readings.title: Fragments: October 28
readings.story: 技术圈里常有一种零散记录：作者把最近看到的小事、想法和讨论攒在一起，过一阵集中写出来。对读者来说，这类文字往往比正式长文更接近一个人真实的关注点。Martin Fowler 的这篇就属于这种形式，日期本身说明它是某个时间点上的观察集合。值得读的地方在于，它不像专题文章那样先给结论，而是把技术、行业和公司建设里的变化并排放在一起，让人自己看出关联。读的时候不妨留意作者挑选了什么、略过了什么，以及他怎样把看似不相干的片段放到同一篇里，这种取舍本身就能帮我们理解他眼中的技术趋势。

companies.name: Socratix AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams.
companies.originalDescription: Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets. Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount. We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and compliance. We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.
companies.story: 这是做金融反欺诈与合规运营的公司。假如你是某家金融科技公司的风控分析师，一个普通工作日的早上打开系统，发现待处理的警报又堆了几百条，你只能在多个工具之间来回切换，把零散信息手动拼起来，再在压力下逐条做判断。Socratix 想做的正是替你分担这部分工作，它提供能实时调查警报的智能体，接入现有工作流程，像人类分析师那样综合各类信号，给出快速且可解释的结论，帮助团队减少欺诈损失、压低误报，并在不增加人手的情况下扩大处理量。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，场景本身也说明了问题：警报数量增长的速度往往快过团队扩编的速度。

companies.name: Callab AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Human-centered AI for contact centers.
companies.originalDescription: Callab AI is a human-centered customer engagement platform for enterprise contact centers. It lets teams deploy AI agents that handle inbound and outbound conversations across voice, chat, and messaging, while human agents and supervisors stay in control of every interaction. The platform has two sides. The AI side lets teams build, deploy, and evaluate voice and text agents using a shared knowledge base, embedded evaluations, post-call analysis, data extraction, batch calling, and call transfer. The human side provides a dialer and a live supervision dashboard, from which a person can watch any AI conversation in real time, step in, and hand it back without the customer repeating a word. Every agent retains memory across channels, so a customer who called yesterday and writes today is recognized and picked up where they left off. The system learns from each human intervention and improves in the direction the team chooses. Callab AI runs on its own carrier-grade telephony stack and connects natively to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX systems. Enterprises can adopt it without migrating to the cloud first. The platform maintains SOC 2 controls and serves customers in financial services, healthcare, hospitality, and retail. Key features: - AI voice and text agents: Agents handle inbound and outbound conversations across phone, chat, and messaging from a single configuration. - Live human supervision: Supervisors watch any AI conversation in real time and take over without the customer repeating a word. - Persistent memory: Every customer's full context is retained across channels and over time. - AI builder: Teams design, test, and deploy agents without engineering support. - Embedded evaluations: Every conversation is scored continuously, so performance is measured rather than assumed. - Self-improving agents: Agents learn from human interventions and get better with every conversation. - Post-call analysis and data extraction: Every conversation becomes structured, searchable records. - Batch calling and call transfer: Outbound campaigns run at scale, and conversations move to a human with full context attached. - Native telephony integration: The platform connects directly to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX without cloud migration. - SOC 2 controls: Security and compliance support deployments in regulated industries. Callab AI delivers every agent production-ready. Our team studies the customer's workflows, internal processes, and existing systems, then builds, tests, and implements the agent on that foundation, so it performs to the organization's own standard from the first live conversation.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是企业联络中心的客户沟通系统。想象你是一家大型企业客服中心的现场主管，屏幕上同时开着几十路对话，其中一部分由智能体接待，你最担心的是机器答错时没人及时发现，客户还要把说过的话再讲一遍。Callab AI 让团队在语音、聊天和消息渠道部署智能体，同时保留人工坐席与主管的控制权，主管可以实时旁听任何一段智能体对话，随时介入，再把对话交还给机器，客户不用重复。系统还会记住跨渠道的对话历史，并从每次人工介入中学习。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队七人，正在招聘，说明这类人机协作的客服模式正在被认真打磨。

companies.name: OS3
companies.originalOneLiner: Affordable, intelligent humanoid robots built to deploy at scale
companies.originalDescription: OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business. Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect. We built OS3 to solve both. Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time. This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford. Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.
companies.story: 这是做人形机器人平台的公司，能力装在实体设备里，不只是手机上的一个应用。如果你是一家工厂或仓库的运营负责人，重复的搬运和分拣工作常年招不满人，而商用机器人报价高得让人下不了手，训练机器人又缺少数据。OS3 想同时解决这两头：两人团队设计了一台美国制造的移动人形机器人，成本远低于商用替代品；在智能方面，他们没有依赖昂贵的机器人采集数据，而是用十五万小时真实视频训练自己的视频动作模型，覆盖两千多个任务，每台部署出去的机器人都会把新经验汇入强化学习流程，让机队逐步自我改进。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Moda
companies.originalOneLiner: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice.
companies.originalDescription: Your agents should never make the same mistake twice. Moda helps you engineer better agents from production data. Find recurring failures, understand what caused them, and build evals from real agent runs. Compare models on the tasks your users actually need. Test changes to your prompts, tools, and workflows against past production traffic before you ship. Know what broke, what to change, and whether the fix worked.
companies.story: 这是帮工程团队改进智能体质量的基础设施公司。如果你是一个负责智能体的工程负责人，上线后最怕的就是用户反复遇到同一类失败，而你在日志里翻半天也说不清到底哪里出了问题。Moda 从生产数据入手，帮你找出反复出现的失败、理解其成因，并用真实运行记录构建评估，让你在用户真正需要的任务上比较不同模型，在发布前用过往生产流量测试提示词、工具和工作流的改动，从而知道什么坏了、该改什么、改完是否有效。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队六人，目前不在招聘。这类工具值得看的地方在于，智能体越往生产环境走，靠感觉调优就越不够用。

companies.name: Rovi Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI healthcare concierge for employees
companies.originalDescription: We deliver high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10–20% of healthcare spend. Employees get concierge care that improves outcomes. Our AI agents analyze clinical data to identify care needs. We treat common conditions through our integrated virtual clinic. For more complex care, our agents find the best in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, and handle end-to-end appointment booking.
companies.story: 这是面向员工提供医疗礼宾服务的数字健康公司。假如你是一家公司的福利负责人，每年医疗支出居高不下，员工却常常不知道该去哪里看、看什么，小问题拖成大问题。Rovi Health 通过短信把医疗服务送到员工手边，它的智能体分析临床数据识别照护需求，常见病症由整合的线上诊所直接处理，更复杂的情况则由智能体借助海量价格与质量数据找到网络内合适的医生，并完成从预约到落地的全流程安排。公司称雇主可削减一到两成的医疗支出，员工则获得改善结果的礼宾式照护。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Galactic Resource Utilization Space, Inc. (GRU Space)
companies.originalOneLiner: Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth
companies.originalDescription: GRU Space is building permanent lunar infrastructure to make humanity interplanetary within our lifetime, starting with the first hotel on the Moon. In just 6 weeks, we built the world's first Moon factory: patent-pending hardware that turns lunar regolith into bricks and inflates modular pressurized habitats designed to withstand lunar temperature and pressure extremes. Our first mission lands on the Moon in 2027 to demonstrate in-situ brick manufacturing and habitat deployment. A second mission lays the hotel's foundation inside a lunar cave, and a third opens the first lunar hotel, targeted for 2032. We don’t stop at Moon hotels. GRU’s long-term plan: 1. Build the first hotel on the Moon. GRU solves off‑world surface habitation. 2. Become the Moon Base Company of America: build roads, mass drivers, warehouses, and physical infrastructure. 3. Repeat on Mars and build the first cities there. 4. Own property on the Moon and Mars as these economies grow. 5. Reinvest profits into resource utilization systems on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and beyond—reaching our final form: Galactic Resource Utilization. GRU Space is backed by investors in SpaceX and Anduril, is part of Nvidia's Inception program, and our launch generated 1B+ views across 60+ countries, earning invitations to the White House, Senate, and Pentagon.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是月球基础设施，方向听起来遥远，但落点很具体。想象你是一名负责月球基地前期建设的任务工程师，最头疼的是把建材从地球运上去成本高得离谱，而月面环境又对温度和压力极其苛刻。GRU Space 用六周时间造出了他们所称的全球首个月球工厂，这套正在申请专利的硬件能把月壤变成砖块，并充气展开模块化加压居住舱。他们的首次任务计划 2027 年登月，演示原位制砖与居住舱部署，第二次任务在月洞内铺设酒店地基，第三次目标是在 2032 年开出首个月球酒店，长期则想成为月面基建公司，再把模式复制到火星。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。

companies.name: ProvenMetal
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native electronics manufacturing for the American industrial base
companies.originalDescription: ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States. Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet. We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
companies.story: 这是做电子制造的公司，切的是美国本土电路板供应链。如果你是一家硬件初创公司的工程负责人，样机改完就等电路板回来，可本土厂商报价高、周期长，回流制造的口号喊了几年，配套供应链却没跟上，项目进度只能干等。ProvenMetal 自称制造美国最快的电路板，把零件采购、可制造性审查和组装这些瓶颈环节自动化，把交付周期从数周压缩到数天。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。值得关注的地方在于，硬件公司对速度的敏感度极高，打样和迭代的节奏往往直接决定产品能否按时推出。

companies.name: Toothy AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI for insurance verification & billing at dental clinics
companies.originalDescription: We’re Toothy.ai. We’re building AI agents for dental practices that handle everything related to patient insurance. The average dental clinic spends over 160 hours a month on insurance tasks like verifying patient policies, billing, and claims processing. Our AI agents automate this entire workflow—including making insurance calls with voice AI—saving clinics time, reducing costs, and ensuring faster reimbursements.
companies.story: 这是给牙科诊所做保险核验与账单处理的公司。假如你是一家牙科诊所的运营负责人，每个月有超过一百六十个小时耗在保险相关事务上，核验患者保单、处理账单、跟进理赔，电话打了一通又一通，前台忙得团团转，回款却总是慢。Toothy AI 用智能体把这一整套流程自动化，包括用语音人工智能直接打电话给保险公司，帮诊所省时间、降成本，并让报销更快到账。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队十五人，正在招聘。这个场景值得看，是因为牙科诊所规模普遍不大，保险事务却格外琐碎，人力很难靠加人解决。

companies.name: Flick
companies.originalOneLiner: We Handle AI. You Direct Films.
companies.originalDescription: Flick is an AI filmmaking software that lets people create Hollywood-level short films completely using AI end-to-end. There are many AI tools that can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to creating truly high-quality films with coherent storylines, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow. Founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding engineer at Instagram, Flick defines an interface specifically designed for native AI filmmaking that feels natural and enables end-to-end creative flows. Think of Flick as Figma for AI filmmaking. There are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards in international film festivals already and our early creator residency community are generating several AI short films every week. We are also building a community where we produce our own AI films as well as collaborating with other well-known filmmakers to share their “behind-the-scenes” workflows as resuable templates to inspire users in our community. We not only build product, we also build world-class content. The whole film industry will be revolutionized by AI and our goal is to be “the product” that defines this category.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能电影创作软件的公司。想象你是一位独立导演，脑子里有一个完整的短片故事，可市面上的生成工具只能给你八秒钟的零散片段，角色前后不一致，镜头之间接不上，创作流程被切得七零八落。Flick 想做的是让人工智能端到端完成一部短片的创作，界面专为这种原生流程设计，创始人把它比作人工智能电影创作领域的 Figma，让创作者保有控制权和连贯的创作节奏。据公司介绍，已有四部用它完成的短片在国际电影节拿到二十多个奖项，早期创作者社区每周都在产出新片。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Prana
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
companies.originalDescription: Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits. Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions. Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions. This allows us to offer 24/7 physician care for a fraction of the cost of traditional care. The Team: - Meer Patel (CEO): JHU BME. Deferred Brown Medical School to build Prana because code scales better than appointments. - Vishvam Rawal (CTO): Ex-Quant. Building high-frequency data infrastructure for health signals. - Sanjit Menon (CHO): Graduating MD Candidate. Deep clinical expertise to ensure our models practice good medicine. Traction: Live in beta with early users.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能初级保健服务的公司。如果你是一个平时不太去医院的人，每年一次十五分钟体检之外，身体指标的细微下滑往往没人盯着，等到发现时已经拖成了问题。Prana 想把这套被动模式换成持续主动的照护，它连接你的病历和可穿戴设备，监测所谓临床漂移，捕捉医生在两次就诊之间容易漏掉的缓慢变化。与多数只是聊天机器人的人工智能健康应用不同，它自称是全栈医疗服务提供方，人工智能像随时在线的医生一样看数据、解释化验结果、管理处方，同时把九成的病史采集、事务安排和分诊等基础工作自动化，让人工医生专注关键决策。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人。

readings.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
readings.story: 每逢加税或政策风向变化，总有人问：那些有钱人会不会搬走？普通人关心的是税能不能收上来，创业者关心的是自己会不会被顺带波及。这篇报道讲的是亿万富翁 Palmer Luckey 面对加州财富税时的表态，值得读的地方在于，它把“富人用脚投票”这个常见想象放回到一个具体的人身上，让你看到真实的选择可能比口号复杂。读的时候可以留意作者怎么交代背景、怎么引用当事人的话，以及他有没有追问：留下或离开，究竟取决于税本身，还是别的什么。

readings.title: Introducing the Cloudflare PHP Capture the Flag challenge
readings.story: 写 PHP 的人大概都有过这种时刻：代码跑起来了，但你不确定它到底安全不安全。这类担心平时藏在日常开发里，直到有人把它变成一场比赛。Cloudflare 办的这个 PHP 安全夺旗挑战，就是让参与者去攻击、去发现漏洞，在解题中理解代码会在哪里出错。它值得读，是因为它展示了一家公司怎么把内部关心的安全问题变成对外可参与的形式。读的时候可以看题目怎么设计、难度怎么分层，以及组织者希望参与者带走什么。

readings.title: Show HN: Diagonals (Diago) – a chess variation where the pieces stay diagonally
readings.story: 做小产品的人常有一种冲动：把一个大家熟悉的东西改一条规则，看看会变成什么样。国际象棋被改了无数次，这次有人让棋子只能沿对角线走，还把它做成了能直接玩的网页，放到 Hacker News 上。它值得读，不是因为规则多深奥，而是因为它是一个完整的示范：一个想法怎么在几天内变成别人能上手试的东西。读的时候可以留意作者怎么介绍规则、怎么处理例外情况，以及社区里的人在争论什么，是玩法本身，还是这种动手做的劲头。

companies.name: HyperProbe
companies.originalOneLiner: AI engineer that debugs and fixes production incidents in realtime
companies.originalDescription: With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data. HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs. Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction. We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.
companies.story: 这是做软件运行时可观测性的公司。想象你是一名负责线上服务的工程负责人，半夜被告警叫醒，日志和追踪数据都是给人看的，智能体拿着这些扁平信息很难还原崩溃那一刻内存里到底发生了什么。HyperProbe 的做法是把探针直接注入正在运行的服务，在故障瞬间读取精确的变量状态，不需要重新部署，处理器开销控制在百分之一以内，还会自动脱敏个人信息。它属于 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队八人，正在招聘。当越来越多智能体参与写代码和运维，让它们真正看懂自己造出的系统就成了刚需，这正是这家公司值得关注的地方。

companies.name: Adialante
companies.originalOneLiner: Cancer screening without barriers
companies.originalDescription: We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是癌症筛查的医学影像设备。假如你是一家社区医疗机构的运营负责人，想给病人加一项核磁筛查，却被告知设备要花数百万美元、安装要等几个月，还得配高水平技术员。Adialante 从物理、算法和硬件重新设计核磁，做成装在轮子上的移动影像诊所，机构不用买设备也不用建基础设施，按次付费就能提供筛查，先从前列腺癌做起。它属于 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。早发现能大幅改善癌症结局，而把门槛降下来正是让这件事覆盖更多人的关键。

companies.name: Pomerado
companies.originalOneLiner: Turn any website into an MCP for your agents, in minutes
companies.originalDescription: Pomerado turns any website into an API / MCP in minutes. Connect your agents to legacy portals, consumer websites, and internal tools. Why Pomerado: • 7x faster than browser agents on customer workflows • 100x cheaper than browser agents • Self healing, deterministic APIs • Universal website coverage • Hosting, authentication, and permissions handled Customers can use us to: • automate back office workflows on legacy systems (ERP, EHR, CRM) • speed up customer integrations for forward deployments • connect enterprise assistants to internal tools • supercharge personal assistants with fast and reliable browser use We’re ex-McKinsey and Scale AI. We drove enterprise agent deployments at F500s and orgs like the Mayo Clinic. We saw how legacy systems block agent development and AI transformations; Pomerado turns those systems into AI-native components automatically.
companies.story: 这是做网站接口化与智能体接入工具的公司。如果你负责一家企业的后台自动化，每天要在老旧的企业管理系统、病历系统或客户系统里重复点选录入，浏览器智能体又慢又贵还容易出错。Pomerado 能在几分钟内把任意网站变成接口或智能体可调用的服务，号称比浏览器智能体快七倍、便宜一百倍，并且自带修复能力、托管、认证和权限管理。它属于 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人。老旧系统一直是智能体落地的拦路石，把这类系统自动变成原生组件，场景本身就值得看。

companies.name: Hypercubic
companies.originalOneLiner: Agentic AI for Mainframe Operations and Modernization
companies.originalDescription: Hypercubic is an AI-native platform for mainframe operations and modernization. We help enterprises understand and modernize their mission-critical legacy systems. About 70% of the Fortune 500 companies still rely on them to run their core business applications in banking, insurance, telecom, airlines, retail, and more. These systems, originally built in the 1960s–90s, still power trillions in global infrastructure today but have become increasingly opaque as original developers retire or leave the workforce. We are pioneering a new class of intelligence capable of understanding, reasoning about, and rebuilding the world’s foundational infrastructure. Learn more at hypercubic.ai
companies.story: 这家公司做的是大型机运维与现代化。想象你是一家银行或保险公司的技术负责人，核心业务还跑在几十年前搭的大型机上，当年写代码的人陆续退休，系统越来越像一个没人看得懂的黑箱。Hypercubic 用原生人工智能平台帮企业理解、推理并重建这些关键遗留系统。它属于 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。据其介绍，财富五百强中约七成仍依赖大型机支撑核心业务，这类基础设施承载着巨大体量，却面临知识断层的现实压力，这就是它值得关注的原因。

companies.name: Pocket
companies.originalOneLiner: Take Notes in the Real World
companies.originalDescription: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能录音笔这类随身硬件。如果你是一个会议很多的咨询顾问，一天连开四五场会，边听边记常常顾此失彼，掏出手机录音又容易分心。Pocket 把录音与转写能力放进一台专门的设备里，让它不只是手机上的一个应用，而是随身场景中的独立工具，强调品质与速度。它属于 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三十五人，正在招聘，并称正在美国与欧洲市场快速扩张。硬件加软件的完整体验能否成为这一品类的主力，是它值得关注的地方。

companies.name: Lux Foods
companies.originalOneLiner: Crops engineered for premium fruit, grown without sunlight.
companies.originalDescription: Lux Foods engineers ultra-compact plants that produce mostly fruit, then grows them on sugar with 90% less light. We design the biology and hardware together to make robotic farming easier. Starting with cherry tomatoes, we’re building year-round production of flavorful, nutritious, pesticide-free fruit near the people who eat it. Our tomatoes have been grown on the International Space Station, and now we're taking this technology to Earth.
companies.story: 这是做细胞农业与机器人种植的公司。假如你是一个连锁餐饮的采购负责人，冬天想稳定拿到风味好的番茄，却受制于产地、季节和农药问题。Lux Foods 通过改造植物，让植株变得超紧凑、主要长果实，再用糖作为能量来源，把光照需求降低约九成，并把生物学与硬件一起设计，让机器人种植更容易。它从樱桃番茄起步，目标是靠近消费者做全年生产。团队四人，属于 YC 秋季 2026 批次。其番茄曾在国际空间站上种植，如今把这套技术带回地球，这个背景让它的方向值得留意。

companies.name: DeepAware AI (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley)
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots, parts & RL envs & evals - delivered in 48 hrs / pickup in SF.
companies.originalDescription: DeepAware (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, https://roboticscenter.ai/) is the fastest way for enterprises and researchers to get robots and robotics parts in the US — 72-hour delivery or Bay Area pickup. Beyond hardware, we help teams collect teleoperation data, build reinforcement learning environments, and deploy robots into production. Customers include AI labs, industrial operations, research teams, and event producers.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机器人硬件与配套数据服务。想象你是一个研究团队的工程负责人，实验要用某种机械臂和零件，采购流程却要等上几周，强化学习环境和遥操作数据也得从头搭。DeepAware 自称是美国拿到机器人与零件最快的方式，七十二小时送达或湾区自取，还帮团队采集遥操作数据、搭建强化学习环境并把机器人部署到生产中。它属于 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，客户包括人工智能实验室、工业运营方、研究团队和活动制作方。硬件加数据加部署的组合，是它值得看的地方。

companies.name: ANORIA
companies.originalOneLiner: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
companies.originalDescription: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是读取情绪的可穿戴设备。如果你是一个需要频繁与人协作的团队负责人，常常事后才意识到自己没读懂对方的情绪，错过了沟通的时机。ANORIA 把传感器放进随身佩戴的设备里，让它不只是手机上的一个应用，而是持续感知你的情绪状态，告诉你原因，并给出可以做的事，把情绪能力变成可以训练的东西。它属于 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队五人。睡眠、恢复、步数都已被追踪，情绪这条反馈回路却一直缺位，这个空白本身就是它值得关注的理由。

companies.name: Torus
companies.originalOneLiner: Legora for physical engineering firms
companies.originalDescription: Torus lets engineering firms and project owners build infrastructure 10x faster to reindustrialize America and the West. We're working with multiple Fortune 500 companies to build critical infrastructure including data centers and critical energy installations.
companies.story: 这是做工程与基础设施行业企业软件的公司。假如你是一家工程公司的项目负责人，手上同时推进数据中心和能源设施，图纸、审批、变更和各方沟通把进度拖得很慢。Torus 面向工程公司与项目业主，帮他们更快建成实体基础设施，定位类似面向实体工程公司的智能助手。它属于 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在招聘，并称正与多家财富五百强公司合作建设数据中心和关键能源设施。再工业化需要把工程流程提速，这类客户信号让它的方向值得关注。

companies.name: AbInitio Bio
companies.originalOneLiner: The Intelligence layer for Drug Manufacturing
companies.originalDescription: Abinitio Bio builds foundation models for biomanufacturing, validated against wet lab data. Our first model, Echo, predicts manufacturing outcomes more accurately than standard models, and any pharma or CDMO can adapt it to their own workflow instantly. By making process decisions that take 6-18 months today in hours, we help teams avoid the cost of delay on a single program.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是生物制药生产环节的智能模型。想象你是一家药企的工艺负责人，一个生产参数调整往往要等六到十八个月才能拿到湿实验室结果，单个项目的延期成本很高。AbInitio Bio 构建面向生物制造的基础模型，并用湿实验室数据验证，首个模型 Echo 在预测生产结果上比标准模型更准，药企或代工企业可以快速把它适配到自己的流程。它属于 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人。把以月计的生产决策压缩到以小时计，正是它值得关注的地方。

readings.title: A Record 8,625 Startups Raised Their First Venture Round This Year. Smaller VCs Now Have to Find Founders Before They Found Anything.
readings.story: 如果你在一家小基金或者刚入行的投资机构做事，大概会有这种体会：好项目好像总在别人手里，等消息传到自己这边，融资已经结束了。今年有创纪录数量的创业公司拿到了第一轮融资，这听起来是热闹的好消息，可对规模不大的投资人来说，意味着竞争更早、更隐蔽。这篇值得读的地方在于，它把镜头对准了这种位置变化：当越来越多公司能拿到钱，找项目的方式也得跟着变。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述这个转折，以及他判断小机构该在哪个时间点介入，是等公司成型，还是更早去认识人。

readings.title: Matiks raises $10M to expand its math and puzzle gaming platform
readings.story: 做数学题和拼图，很多人小时候都玩过，但把它做成一个能持续吸引人、还能赚钱的产品，是另一回事。当一类游戏被证明有人愿意每天打开，资本就会开始问：它能不能长大，能不能扩到更多科目和更多国家。Matiks 拿到一千万美元去扩展它的数学与解谜平台，正好落在这样一个节点上。读这篇时，不妨带着一个具体问题：作者有没有说清楚这笔钱要花在哪，是拉新、做内容，还是进新市场。也可以看它怎么解释用户为什么留下来，而不只是说这个品类很热。

readings.title: Show HN: Building the European Company Graph one website at a time
readings.story: 平时查一家欧洲公司，你可能要在好几个网站之间来回翻，信息散落，格式也不一样。有人干脆自己动手，一个网站一个网站地抓，慢慢拼出一张欧洲公司关系图，然后把它放到 Hacker News 上给人看。这类项目往往不是大公司立项做出来的，而是某个人被具体麻烦逼出来的。它值得读，是因为你能看到一个数据产品最原始的样子：先解决自己的问题，再看别人要不要。读的时候重点看作者怎么定义范围，先收哪些公司、怎么判断一条信息算不算可靠，以及他打算让别人怎么用这张图。

companies.name: Tasklet
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents that own the work
companies.originalDescription: AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated. Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk operations, it writes and runs code in a cloud sandbox. When it needs to interact with a website that doesn't have an API, it uses a real browser. And because it runs in the cloud 24/7, you can set up triggers to have it take ongoing responsibility for workflows — not just do something once, but handle it going forward. The product is deliberately simple: a chat interface where you talk to an extremely capable agent. But underneath that simplicity is a cloud-native agent runtime, best-in-class context engineering, a universal connections layer, and multi-model support that keeps us on the frontier as AI improves. We think legacy SaaS is being unbundled by agents, and Tasklet is the operating system that ties it all together.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能智能体的公司，让智能体真正接手日常工作。假如你是销售主管，每天要在客户关系管理系统、邮箱和表格之间来回切换，手动整理线索和更新记录，一天下来真正谈客户的时间所剩无几。Tasklet 能连接你用的各种工具，通过内置集成、接口或协议服务器，代替你执行拉取报告、更新客户关系管理系统、分类邮件、处理数据等操作，需要界面时还能即时生成，需要算数或批量操作时会在云端沙箱里写代码运行，遇到没有接口的网站则用真实浏览器操作，而且它二十四小时在云端运行，你可以设置定时任务让它持续工作。这支 YC 春季 2026 的团队目前有八人并在招聘，场景本身值得看，因为知识工作者大量时间耗在工具切换和重复劳动上。

companies.name: Runtime
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI agent harness for payment teams
companies.originalDescription: Runtime helps fast-growing fintechs build and run AI agents for mission-critical payment and risk operations. Teams turn their procedures into specialized agents that work across their systems, with scoped access, human approvals, and a full audit trail.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是支付团队的人工智能智能体运行环境。如果你是一家快速增长的金融科技公司的风控分析师，每天要按流程核对交易、处理异常并留下审批记录，步骤多、系统杂，稍有疏漏就可能带来风险。Runtime 让团队把内部操作流程变成专门的智能体，让它们在各个系统之间执行任务，同时提供限定范围的访问权限、人工审批环节和完整的审计记录。这样重复的支付与风控操作可以交给智能体按规矩跑，人只负责关键判断。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队七人且正在招聘，值得关注是因为支付和风控这类任务对权限与审计要求很高，能把智能体安全地放进这类流程本身就是一个具体问题。

companies.name: Synapse Semiconductor
companies.originalOneLiner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
companies.originalDescription: We want to push machines to where humans cant go. Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.
companies.story: 这是做边缘计算半导体的硬科技公司，把计算和视觉能力合并到传感器层面。想象你负责一台在危险或人难以到达的环境里作业的机器，它需要实时看懂周围，但把图像传回云端既慢又费带宽，很多数据其实机器并不需要。Synapse Semiconductor 正在研发一种新的视觉传感器，能在相机像素里直接运行神经网络滤波，只采集机器真正关心的数据。这不是一个手机应用，而是把能力放进芯片和传感器里，让设备在本地就完成判断。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有两人且正在招聘，方向涉及机器人、国防等场景，值得看是因为物理智能要发展，机器必须先在自己的硬件上理解世界。

companies.name: RunAnywhere
companies.originalOneLiner: Fastest inference anywhere: open models on-prem, hosted or on-device
companies.originalDescription: RunAnywhere runs open-weight models at full speed wherever a company needs them. Wally is our inference stack for open models: serverless inference, BYOC, or on-prem, so code and data never leave their network. One command puts a Wally-served model inside Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, etc. When a model fits on the device, the same tooling runs it locally through our open-source SDKs for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web, built on kernels written by our agentic harness for Apple and Qualcomm silicon (10K+ GitHub stars).
companies.story: 这是做开发者工具和推理基础设施的公司，让开源模型在公司需要的地方全速运行。假如你是工程负责人，公司出于合规要求不能让代码和数据离开自己的网络，但又想用上开源模型的能力。RunAnywhere 提供 Wally 推理栈，支持无服务器推理、自带云环境或本地部署，一条命令就能把模型接进 Claude Code、Codex 等编码工具；当模型能装进设备时，同一套工具还能通过开源开发包在 iOS、安卓、macOS、Windows、Linux 和网页上本地运行，这些开发包建立在为苹果和高通芯片编写的内核之上，相关项目在 GitHub 上已获得一万多颗星。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人且正在招聘，值得关注是因为数据不出网络和端侧运行是很多公司真实存在的约束。

companies.name: Synphony
companies.originalOneLiner: robots & software for farms
companies.originalDescription: Strawberry farming is a $3B industry in California alone with 60% labor cost using 40-year old software. Synphony provides strawberry picking robots and software services including: bed-level analytics, data pipeline integration, and agentic solutions. Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products used by IRS and Citibank. Lucas' research spanned robotics, IoT devices, and neuromorphic computing. Alex architected an app with 400k users.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是农场用的机器人和软件，先从草莓种植切入。如果你负责一片草莓农场的运营，采收季最头疼的就是人手：找工人难、成本高，而地里每天的情况又只能靠人走一圈去看。Synphony 提供草莓采摘机器人，以及床级数据分析、数据管道集成和智能体方案，让农场主能看到每块地的情况并减少对人工的依赖。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十人，输入提到加州草莓产业规模约三十亿美元、人工占成本约六成，团队还一起赢过十五场以上黑客松。值得看的是它把机器人放进真实的户外农田，同时用数据服务支撑后续更通用的机器人部署。

companies.name: Klarify
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agent for Therapists
companies.originalDescription: Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients. Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it. Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients. Nearly 12,300 therapists use Klarify today. Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.
companies.story: 这是做心理治疗师后台运营的人工智能公司。一个治疗师每天除了坐在来访者对面，还要写临床记录、制定治疗计划、填保险理赔、写信件、做督导准备，常常忙到深夜。Klarify 里的智能体 Klara 接手这些事，包括记录、治疗计划、临床信件、保险理赔、两次会谈之间的资源、督导准备以及寻找新客户。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘，输入提到目前已有近一万两千三百名治疗师在使用。值得关注的是，治疗师人数有限而文书负担沉重，把行政工作交出去能让他们把精力放回只有人才能做的事，也就是真正陪伴来访者。

companies.name: Huscarl
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native actuary enabling self-insurance for corporations
companies.originalDescription: Huscarl is building an autonomous AI actuary to enable self-insurance for corporations. Large companies use insurance subsidiaries ("captives") to self-insure their risks. Some of these captives are larger than regional insurers. We provide them the actuarial and modeling layer to operate and grow. We're building a future where self-insurance is the default, and commercial insurance the exception. This is the best way to solve the inefficiencies of the $1T corporate insurance market.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是企业自保所需的精算能力，用自主人工智能精算师替代部分传统流程。如果你在一家大公司负责风险与保险，可能会用自保子公司来承担自身风险，但这类子公司要运转和扩张，离不开精算与建模，而懂这行的人并不好找。Huscarl 提供的就是这一层精算和建模工具，让自保子公司能自己运营和成长。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，方向指向规模约一万亿美元的企业保险市场。值得看的是它押注自保成为默认、商业保险成为例外的未来，这个判断本身就决定了产品要解决的是精算能力供给不足的问题。

companies.name: Stoa
companies.originalOneLiner: The market behind AI hardware.
companies.originalDescription: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能硬件交易基础设施的公司，给算力买卖提供定价和交易的市场。想象你是一家公司的采购负责人，需要买到一批图形处理器，但市场价格不透明，卖家资质参差不齐，谈价和验货都很费劲。Stoa 已经上线一个询价市场，让公司通过经过审核的经销商实时买卖图形处理器，并提供定价与交易所需的基础设施。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘，标签涉及金融科技、硬件和市场。值得关注的是，算力已经成为紧俏资源，而交易环节仍然缺少透明、可信的市场机制，这正是它要补上的位置。

companies.name: Ultrasonium
companies.originalOneLiner: Metal manufacturing, faster, cheaper, and more versatile.
companies.originalDescription: The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous. Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority. Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.
companies.story: 这是做金属制造硬件的公司，目标是让复杂金属零件造得更快、更便宜、更灵活。假如你是一家航空航天或能源公司的制造工程师，手上有一个形状复杂的零件，铸造和机加工都做不出来，剩下能用的先进方法又慢又贵还有风险。Ultrasonium 发明了一种新的制造方法，输入固态金属原料，输出成品零件，整个过程由物理智能层和新控制工艺管理，据其介绍比被替代的方法快十五倍、便宜百分之七十五，并且能在美国规模化生产。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人，方向涉及数据中心、火箭、卫星和机器人所需的关键零件。值得看的是，这类零件需求正在上升，而国内制造能力本身也是被重视的问题。

companies.name: Janeen
companies.originalOneLiner: Prior auths and benefits investigation for infusion clinics
companies.originalDescription: Janeen is built for infusion clinics. We handle prior authorizations and benefit investigations from start to finish (actually though!). Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. We work with clinics across the country and have removed 95% of all manual labor in the process.
